entities.name: Rinni
entities.description: A veteran Rakdos performer whose pyrotechnic revue is famous, and who mentors Lunicia.

entities.name: Ginoria
entities.description: A Rakdos performer in Rinni's revue who produces ichor from her fingertips.

entities.name: Nikori
entities.description: A Rakdos high-chain performer in Rinni's revue.

entities.name: Silar
entities.description: A fat Orzhov priest who attends Rinni's shows and collects souvenirs.

entities.name: Lunicia
entities.description: A young unguilded acrobat who wants to join the Rakdos revue.

entities.name: Minyuli
entities.description: A performer whose act, the Projection of Pain, involves being tortured by a goblin assistant.

entities.name: The Demon
entities.description: The demon the Rakdos guild exists to entertain and appease so that it returns to slumber.

entities.name: Juri
entities.description: A rival circus that Lunicia threatens to join.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The guild of performers and revelers devoted to the Demon.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: The guild of priests and debt, to which Silar belongs.

entities.name: Paruns
entities.description: The nine guild leaders who gave the Demon a guild to entertain him.

entities.name: The Firemind
entities.description: The only one remaining who knows what the Demon is truly capable of.

entities.name: Carnarium
entities.description: The Rakdos circus hall where the revue performs.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius city near which street magicians perform.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The law guild whose arbiters once tipped their hats to Rinni.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild whose potion Rinni uses to fuel his act.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The guild that makes tonics Rinni uses.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild that cultivates the balm Rinni uses.

events.summary: Rinni's revue performs a chaotic show at the Carnarium; Nikori is knocked unconscious in the rubble.
events.quote: Nikori always had a problem with dismounts.

events.summary: Silar greets Ginoria, who rebuffs him with a quip about debts.
events.quote: Debts, like compliments, are best paid by the dead,

events.summary: Lunicia asks to join the revue; Rinni mocks and drops her, and she spits in his face before escaping into the rafters.
events.quote: I wish to join the revue.

events.summary: Rinni declines to have Lunicia found, admiring her fire.
events.quote: She has the fire. It is pleasure to see it in one so young.

events.summary: Rinni tends his wounds with Simic, Izzet and Selesnya remedies and sleeps.
events.quote: He finally found and opened a jar of balm, cultivated by the Selesnya

events.summary: Two nights later Rinni finds Lunicia in the scaffolding watching Minyuli's act.
events.quote: He found her in the scaffolding near the Carnarium's roof

events.summary: Rinni introduces himself and Lunicia gives her name.
events.quote: Lunicia the Tremendous. At least someday.

events.summary: Rinni explains the Rakdos purpose of appeasing the Demon through performance.
events.quote: so that the Demon can return peacefully to his slumber.

events.summary: Rinni signs and dates a paper for Lunicia and invites her to watch the show.
events.quote: He signed and dated the paper.

events.summary: Rinni, Ginoria and Nikori perform a fire and ichor act.
events.quote: Rinni and Ginoria locked arms with each other and begun to spin impossibly fast around the stage.

events.summary: Rinni performs his final showstopper, and the Demon's chuckle is heard throughout the hall.
events.quote: The low and rumbling chuckle of the Demon could be heard throughout the hall

events.summary: Lunicia decides she needs allies in other guilds and takes items from Rinni's dressing room to approach Silar.
events.quote: she would need to acquire allies in other guilds.

relations.note: Rinni offers her guidance on Rakdos life
relations.quote: Rakdos performers do not grow old in the ring,
Ginoria and Rinni stepped off the stage, hand in hand
We Rakdos, we perform—we live and we die—to appease him
